subject: Discovery recap — propose two 30m bands and nominate SME
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@atlashealth.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap — propose two 30m bands and nominate SME

Hi Jennifer / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Atlas Health is focused on reducing inference latency for patient summarization pipelines and wants predictable cost/throughput for peak hours. Key stakeholders to include for the next session are product (decision-maker), infra/security (SSO/data residency), and an engineer who owns the pipeline.

Next step: short 30-minute product intro (compact demo + one infra slide). To keep this tight, can you pick one of these two windows (both PT):
- Option A: Wed, May 6 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Thu, May 7 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither works, propose one alternative and we’ll adapt. Please also confirm the two internal attendees you want on the call (decision-maker + infra/security).

I’ve tentatively nominated Karthik Iyer from our team as the technical SME for the session (CC’d). Marissa Cole (CC) will own the mutual action plan. I’m attaching a short pre-demo questionnaire and a draft MAP to help us focus the 30 minutes.

Attachments: pre-demo-questions.docx, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Proposed 30-min agenda (we'll stick to time):
- 0–5m: quick intros & success criteria
- 5–20m: product walkthrough focused on latency/cost controls
- 20–25m: infra/security notes (SSO, VPC options)
- 25–30m: next steps / decision points

Thanks — hoping we can lock a time so Karthik can prepare the brief infra snippet.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@atlashealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — propose two 30m bands and nominate SME

Thanks Grace — concise and helpful. Both windows look possible on our side, but if we need to prioritize, Thu May 7 at 2:00 PM PT would be slightly better for the infra folks.

Quick notes:
- I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@atlashealth.com) for visibility; they may have a scheduling preference for execs.
- We’ll aim to have our Product Director (me) and one infra engineer on the call. I can invite our Security Lead if needed but would prefer to do a short pre-read first.

Can you share a one-slide outline of the infra/security bullets you plan to cover? Also curious if you can briefly address SSO (Okta) in that 5-minute infra slot.

Jennifer Lee
Director of Product, Atlas Health
jennifer.lee@atlashealth.com | (617) 555-0199

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
